kmer_order: product(alphabet, repeat=k); RNA then structure; increasing k
kmer_normalization: overlapping counts divided by valid windows for each k; zero if none
structure_orientation: left_to_right; do not reverse or symmetrize
nonfinite_mfe: NaN; median imputation fitted on training only
preprocessing: clip standardized values to [-8,8]; float32; retain constant columns

added_feature_rules.positions: zero-based; depth immediately after processing each character
added_feature_rules.windows: 8 equal 25-nt bins, 4 equal 50-nt bins for length 200; centered windows 40/80/120/160 clipped to input length
added_feature_rules.normalization: all added lengths, depths and topology counts divided by full sequence length; fractions use their stated eligible populations
added_feature_rules.stems: maximal consecutive nested pair chains; longest tie broken by smallest outer left coordinate
added_feature_rules.pair_categories: canonical paired endpoints only, excluding N/noncanonical endpoints from all composition denominators
added_feature_rules.triplet: mask bits left,center,right; 1=paired; denominator eligible canonical central positions excluding endpoints
added_feature_rules.undefined: zero; population standard deviation (ddof=0); linear quantiles
added_feature_rules.external_pair: fraction of ALL window positions paired to an endpoint outside the window
added_feature_rules.no_pairs: all pair/stem/loop summaries and coordinates zero
added_feature_rules.center: longest stem center distance uses (n-1)/2; straddling uses i<n/2<=j

fine_structure_rules.parser: balanced dot-bracket; partner=-1 if unpaired; depth after processing each character
fine_structure_rules.bin_order: b=0..19; positions [10*b,10*b+10); six statistics in feature-name order
fine_structure_rules.paired_fraction: number of positions with p[i]>=0 divided by 10
fine_structure_rules.mean_absolute_partner_displacement: mean(abs(p[i]-i))/200 over paired bin positions; zero if none; partners from full window

structural_geometry.coordinates: zero-based; L=200; post-character depth; orientation unchanged
structural_geometry.position_order: i=0..199: (i+partner[i])/(2L), maximal contiguous stack pair count/L; both zero if unpaired
structural_geometry.stack: maximal chain (a,b),(a+1,b-1),...; same total length for every member pair
structural_geometry.terminal_loop: pair with no child pairs; interior consists only of dots (may be empty)
structural_geometry.loop_order: sort by (abs((a+b)/2-99.5),a,b); retain five; zero pad ten values per missing record
summary_order: fraction of interval positions in terminal-loop interiors
count of pairs with a<100-r and b>=100+r divided by L
count of terminal-loop pairs with both endpoints inside interval/L
